name: Runtime - Embedding Keepalive Guard
contract_reason: A cold Ollama embedding load costs 4-7s and consumes a large share of the memory_search tool deadline, which has produced hard recall failures on the first search of a session. This job keeps the embedding model resident so recall does not degrade after idle periods or an Ollama restart.
description: Keeps the local Ollama memory-search embedding model resident so the first memory_search of a session does not pay a 4-7s cold-load penalty against the tool deadline. Local embedding residency only: no config/auth/service/schedule mutation, no external delivery, no finance/canon/capital/account authority.
stop_lines: Contract validation only; do not add, update, remove, enable, disable, reschedule, or force-run the cron job from this artifact.
The job may load an embedding model into the local Ollama server and may not change OpenClaw config, auth, credentials, channels, services, startup, plugins, or network state.
No finance, canon, portfolio, cash, sizing, capital, paper/live, brokerage, account, or execution action.
No deletion, archive, external delivery, skill application, or owner approval inference.
contract_update_reason: Pin command argv to CPython 3.13 and restore enabled after Gateway python ENOENT auto-disable.
